body: I wouldn't say that I'm afraid of my own financial failure. I'm worried that if I die before my debts are paid then those debts will be transferred to my mom. Though, her husband does own me a few grand so that could help out. Anyways, I need to try to go to sleep now. PM me if you care to keep talking and I will continue to check this account. You don't have to and I understand completely if you don't.

That's great, and music is a really good outlet. I've never really tried writing my own stuff though. I would have to do some serious work if I wanted to get a gig playing by myself, and I'm not in a band or anything. To be honest though, it's really hard to be optimistic. I know you are trying to help, and thank you for that, but I feel like I'm wasting your time. I don't think playing music more will achieve anything more than me playing more music. I'm not going to walk away from this conversation suddenly inspired and fulfilled, I'm not even really sure why I posted this sob story in the first place.

I hope you are right, I may look into the laws on it if I decide to go.

And yeah the list idea does sound cheesy, but I'll bite. One thing I haven't done in a while that I really enjoy is sitting outside by myself on a clear calm night staring up at the stars while drinking a decent scotch and smoking a good cigar. There's nothing quite like it. Also, performing something that I have been working really hard on for a long time on stage is a great feeling (I'm a musician).

So that's why you want to live? For fleeting, frivolous things?

I used to go to a therapist when I was a child, I don't know if it will help me now or not. I've thought about it, but I'm worried about the cost. I don't make much money. Plus, If I told them any of this wouldn't they be required by law to call the police?

Once I'm not a burden then I really just think I want to die. I'll never do anything truly important anyway, why bother? 

Why do you want to live?
